one_line: AI funding surges, security gaps widen, and compute platforms expand worldwide.

themes.title: AI firms secure record funding
themes.text: DeepSeek raised about $15 billion and OpenAI is negotiating up to $30 billion, valuing the latter at $1.25 trillion.

stories.headline: DeepSeek raises about $15 billion in funding round days after US restrictions
OpenAI seeks up to $30 billion funding at $1.25 trillion valuation ahead of IPO

themes.title: AI tools expose security vulnerabilities
themes.text: AI models identified critical PHP memory‑safety bugs affecting up to 70 % of websites; Chinese hackers used AI agents to breach thousands of Microsoft 365 tenants; major US banks are blocking third‑party AI agents after unauthorized activity.

stories.headline: AI tools uncover critical PHP vulnerabilities affecting up to 70% of websites
Chinese hackers used AI agents to breach ConnectWise and access 2,250 Microsoft 365 tenants
Major US banks block third‑party AI agents from customer accounts

themes.title: AI compute and platform growth
themes.text: NVIDIA launched the Minerva AIOps platform for AI factory observability; SpaceX targets 13 GW AI compute capacity by 2027; Polarise introduced a sovereign European AI cloud; Schneider Electric partnered with NVIDIA and HPE to deliver edge AI agents; Firebird secured 45,000 Grace GPUs for Kazakhstan data centers.

stories.headline: NVIDIA launches Minerva AIOps platform for AI factory observability
SpaceX aims for 13 GW AI compute capacity by end of 2027
Polarise launches sovereign AI cloud at NVIDIA GTC Berlin
Schneider Electric, NVIDIA and HPE launch Industrial AI Agents at the Edge
Kazakhstan expands AI compute with 45,000 Grace GPUs and new data centers
